comment: Awesome professor with such passion for Business Info Systems.  She gets really excited over vigorous discussion.  Grading is an easy A-, but you'll actually have to work hard for the A as the bar is set at 95, and little errors will harm you.
Really useful class. However she jus send assignment without even explain them to you, you will have to figure them out on your way. Classes are really interesting and make sure you participate!

Deans is such a nice woman.  I took her for the required IT type class and got an A.  She is very clear and just an all around great lady.  I had no interest in the subject but still did well and liked her.  If you skip class, your grade will be hurt.

Waste of money.  Nothing IT related.  Learn more from popular science magazine.  The university would be better off requiring a Microsoft Office course.  She is a nice lady, and the class is an easy A, but man...what an utter waste of time.  Everything presented in class was completely general without any application.  Not worth the $4-5K.

Great Professor.  As mentioned, she is really easy but you have to be willing to put the work into he take-home exams.  I think I spent like 15 hours on the first one which was by far the longest of the 3.  Great lady!

Dr. Deans is by far the best teacher I have ever had.  A textbook is not required.  Everything you learn is extremely useful.  The tests are take home and long, but if you manage your time you should be able to get an A. The class is fun also because you leard a lot about up to date technology. I have never gotten more out of any other class.
Great teacher but you will need to work for your A. a lot of busy work but better than any other teacher teaching this class. recommended

She is really nice and sweet, willing to help out a lot but be forewarned she gives tough take-home exams and homeworks. she always expects you to participate in discussions. Her exams can be difficult and are very time-consuming. Positive side:she  gives an easy A, but you still have to work for it. Tip: Work hard and you will be fairly rewarded!

Penny Deans is one of my favorite teachers in the B-School.  Not only is she extremely knowledgeable and experienced, but she is a warm sweet woman who is enjoyable to have as a teacher.  Penny Deans is the June Cleaver of the B-School and I want her to be my third grandma.
